item.title: Writing to prompts
item.description: On 25th Aug 26, I asked Claude (Sonnet 5 medium) to give me 6 gothic story premises. Here are the premises: Here are six gothic story premises: 1. The Inherited House A woman inherits a decaying estate from an aunt she never knew, only to discover the will requires her to live there for a full year before she can sell it.
I’m trying to find my feet with this PhD. I think in some ways it was a little poorly scoped in the first place, and therefore I’m getting lost in the weeds.
